programme.desc: Erasto brinda con Serrano y Rivero por la compra de las emisoras y pide documentos falsos del apartamento para callar a Natalia. Arminda espera la hora de vengarse mientras Erasto regala un brillante enorme a Natalia. Alejandro y José Luis se emborrachan en confidencias. La policía registra el cuarto de Rosa y encuentra una bolsa con el dinero del falso robo de Rosalía; la arrestan. Blanca se niega a impedirlo. Marisela golpea a Rosalía y Adolfo interviene. Isaías se niega a perdonar a Consuelo. Rosa es advertida de que pasará mucho tiempo presa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra descubre que Leo entró a su departamento y confronta a Tony y a Maribel, acusándolos del delito y amenazándolos con despedirlos de la empresa y mandarlos a la cárcel. Leo va a casa de María Lucía para reclamar lo que, según su criterio, ella le debe: volver con él a cambio de que él haya averiguado que Rodrigo es el padre de ella. Cuando está a punto de convencerla, entra Trinidad, furiosa. Adolfo le cuenta a Jimena una idea para sacar a Carlos Ernesto del país, pretextando que es por su bien y por el bien de la familia. Rebeca se reencuentra con su médico Edgar Ventura, del cual ha sido y es amante, y juntos planean la mejor forma de acorralar a Leonardo para quedarse con su fortuna.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro son extorsionados por Reina que quiere dinero a cambio de darles la identidad del niño robado. Aida abofetea a Reina y se pone mal, Alejandro y Sol la calman. Y luego le dicen que tiene que hablar pero Aida aún guarda su secreto porque tiene miedo de que Reina la mate.Alejandro se da cuenta de que Aida también dio a luz el mismo día y en la misma clínica que Sol y comienzan las sospechas.Heriberto firma los papeles de divorcio a Sol y le dice que se va a entregar.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri y Wilker siguen besándose en la terraza hasta que llega el momento en que parece que van a llegar más lejos que los simples besos. Yubiri está pensando en que cine estará Wilker viendo la cuña Finita invita a Armando a ir a la azotea. Armando no quiere pero… Toda la familia de Bienvenida atienden a Juan Diego. Están como si tuvieran a un rey en la casa menos Segundo y por supuesto Graciela cuando sabe que es hijo de Atanasio. Yubiri y Wilker están a punto de hacer el amor.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Edén le dice a Monchito que a pesar de su separación sigue cerca de Pascuita. Marco Aurelio lee el libro de Gabito. Rómulo no le pide el divorcio a Betzaida. Santiago sueña con Matilde. Temen por la vida de Gabito. Paco visita a Doroteo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela revela que Moisés y Elizabeth son hermanos, causando gran dolor y descreimiento. Moisés rechaza a Celia por su supuesto abandono, mientras Néstor oculta que está vivo. Ricardo apoya a Elizabeth y defiende a Manuela de Hortensia. Celia enfrenta un embarazo de riesgo bajo reposo médico. Pese a las tensiones y el acoso de Misael, Manuela reafirma su amor por Ricardo y decide divorciarse de él, mientras Katiuska intenta seducirlo aprovechando la crisis familiar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto brinda con Serrano y Rivero por la compra de las emisoras y pide documentos falsos del apartamento para callar a Natalia. Isaías se niega a perdonar a Consuelo. Rosa es advertida de que pasará mucho tiempo presa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene finalmente confirma que el niño que ella espera es de Felipe y Leonardo queda devastado. Rebeca y Agustina tienen una violenta discusión al final de la cual Rebeca amenaza a su hermana. Luego, al regresar Leonardo de su encuentro con Irene, Rebeca le increpa a su marido por la existencia de tantas mujeres en su vida. Rodrigo tiene dudas sobre continuar o no con el plan de destruir a los Ferrándiz por la presencia de Virginia y María Lucía. Se confiesa con Adolfo y este lo insta a olvidarse de todo. Leo y María Lucía son descubiertos besándose por Trinidad. La mujer lo echa de la casa y Leo le roba un beso a la chica. Luego María Lucía le confiesa a su abuela su profundo amor por Leo y esta última trata de persuadirla de alejarse de él.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro se da cuenta de que Aída también dio a luz el mismo día y en la misma clínica que Sol y comienzan las sospechas. Heriberto confiesa haber matado a los Figueras por orden de Reina y también le dice a Maricielo que el móvil era que Eloy engañaba a Reina con la madre de Sol. Sol va a la empresa y reprende a Cristina por su relación con Eloy. Tabares agarra con las manos en la masa a Andrade, el hombre que golpeó a Sol por encargo de Reina.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Graciela casi se muere cuando llega a su casa y se consigue a Atanasio. El dice que viene a ver a Yubiri. En el autobús están Bienvenida y Yubiri van en el autobús para su casa sin saber que Atanasio las está esperando para devolverle el trabajo a Yubiri. Bienvenida no sabe nada de que la botaron. Ana le dice a Mauricio que todo se terminó porque ella es demasiado mujer para el. Pastor | Olegario y Fabián están dibujando el venado para la pancarta y comienzan a hablar de Mauricio.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Marco Aurelio le habla a Eglee del libro de Gabito. Cuando se corre la voz sobre el libro, todo el mundo se interesa por el final de su historia. Matilde aconseja a Dileidy que se quede con quien le dicte su corazón.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia convence a Moisés de vivir con ella, mientras él y Elizabeth aceptan su hermandad. Ricardo y Manuela pasan la noche juntos por la lluvia, pero ella lo rechaza pese a los intentos de él por reconciliarse. Katiuska, furiosa, amenaza a Manuela mientras Hortensia planea arruinar su matrimonio. Marcelo oculta su relación con María del Pilar, y Néstor amenaza a Jade, quien delata a Manuela. Brigitte enfrenta problemas de drogas mientras su familia se preocupa por su bienestar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Andreína sospecha que Rosalía es la culpable y consulta con su padre. Rosalía paga el depósito que la policía retiene. Alejandro decide no ayudar a Rosa, presionado. Eustoquio promete revelar un secreto importante a Rosa. Erasto visita a Eustoquio y se cruza con Rosa burándose de ella. Eustoquio es atacado en prisión y Rosa lo salva gritando pidiendo auxilio. Amalia sufre un accidente en el set y deben operarla en EE.UU. Alejandro pospone la boda con Rosalía. Consuelo contrata al detective Sanabria para investigar a las chicas de la residencia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena va a casa de Virginia a pedirle que convenza a Carlos Ernesto de irse a realizar un tratamiento para extender su expectativa de vida a una clínica en Europa. Alejandra enfrenta a Leo por haber irrumpido en su casa y él acepta toda responsabilidad. Su padre, Leonardo, considera el despedirlo de la empresa. Leo le confiesa a Alejandra que ya sabe que ella vive con Rodrigo y que él es el padre de María Lucía. Sandra persuade a María Lucía de que le de una oportunidad a Leo. Keka, Miguel y Lucas llaman a Irene, pero sus guardaespaldas se lo cuentan a Rebecca y ella les prohíbe volver a comunicarse con ella. Adolfo propone como sucesor del puesto de Finol a Rodrigo y a Carlos Ernesto y a Leonardo no les queda más remedio que aceptar la propuesta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro le dice a Heriberto que Sol siempre será suya y que se olvide de ella. Tabares hace confesar al hombre que golpeó a Sol y por ello apresan a Reina. Reina le dice a Aida que la niña Esperanza no es su hija tampoco. Ricarda le da celos a Tabares con el abogado Agüero. Columba se pregunta si continuar con un hombre tan mujeriego como Eloy. Giselle está decidida a demandar a Bárbara aunque corra el riesgo de que Cristo José termine demandándola a ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Maribel desconfía de Gloria porque cree que está pasando información sobre Leonardo, pero Tony le dice que exagera. Jimena va a visitar a sus nietos que se encuentran castigados y habla con Agustina para que la ayude a controlar a Rebeca. Virginia renuncia a su puesto y le miente a Carlos Ernesto porque cree que así lo está protegiendo. Él habla con María Lucía para descubrir si es verdad lo que le dijo. Leonardo va a la citación para firmar la anulación y trata de hablar con Irene. Esta se niega a cambiar su opinión, mucho más cuando llega Rebeca a la reunión, lo que hace que Leonardo se enoje con ella.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Maricielo decide relajarse y ordenar sus pensamientos dando una caminara por la playa, donde se encuentra con Carlos. Él le confiesa su amor y ellos se besan, pero en ese momento aparece Víctor Hugo. Ricarda y el comisario Tabares se reúnen a cenar y pasan una noche romántica, pero luego el comisario Tabares recibe una llamada que le hace sospecha a Ricarda que él estuvo con otra mujer cuando no estaba con ella, y decide hacerlo sospechar sobre su fidelidad hacia él.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una hábil jugadora de póker arrasa en las mesas una vez en alta mar. Pero después es testigo de un hombre que cae por la borda, muchos empiezan a preguntarse si fue accidental o intencional. ¿Y quién será el siguiente?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una inventora tecnológica de Silicon Valley desaparece a bordo de un barco alquilado, dejando a muchos preguntándose qué le sucedió y si su invento tuvo algo que ver con su desaparición.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un boleto de raspar y ganar es ganador de un viaje en crucero con todos los gastos pagados para una joven pareja. Pero su suerte se agota una vez a bordo del barco, ya que uno de ellos termina asesinado.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una sous chef a bordo de un crucero abandona su turno inesperadamente y nunca más vuelve a ser vista. ¿Alguien a bordo la vio antes de que desapareciera? ¿Qué pistas existen sobre su paradero?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario de vacaciones en un crucero se enfrenta a más de lo que puede manejar cuando lo descubren muerto en la cubierta. ¿Fue un trágico accidente o alguien tenía una cuenta pendiente con este negociador?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un director de crucero es encontrado muerto en el baño. Todas las señales apuntan a un asesinato mientras los investigadores empiezan a revisar las pruebas para descubrir al perpetrador y llevarlo ante la justicia.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una mujer decide tomar en unas vacaciones en crucero sin informar a su familia. Cuando ésta desaparece, su familia busca respuestas y terminará cambiando la forma en que se informa sobre personas desaparecidas en el mar.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una adinerada socialité de San Francisco es asesinada en el mar, golpeada hasta la muerte con una botella de whisky. ¿Podría su mayordomo, que también se alojaba en su habitación, tener alguna pista para resolver este asesinato?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un crucero de reunión de secundaria se vuelve mortal cuando la cerebrito de la clase aparece muerta. ¿Cometió un compañero de clase un terrible acto en su contra? ¿Había alguna cuenta pendiente por saldar?

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Para recaudar fondos para la casa de sus sueños en España, Gemma Dorman se convierte en escort. Pero su plan fracasa cuando Vikram Singh se obsesiona con ella y acecha tanto a Gemma como a su madre.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Originario de Nepal, Roshan Sah tenía un sueño americano: pasar el resto de su vida con una mujer de la que se había enamorado, pero ella no sentía lo mismo. ¿Hasta dónde estaba dispuesto a llegar Roshan?

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Cuando los intentos de Pawel de seducir a la adolescente Agata son recibidos con aprensión, su interés por Agata resulta mortal.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: La trabajadora estudiante Leslie Pinkston se toma una noche libre para conocer a William Gardener, un hombre que conoce de la escuela. Pero pronto descubre que William no es el buen tipo que parece ser.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Lorin LaFave nunca podría haber imaginado que el encuentro en línea de su hijo de 14 años con un ciberacosador adolescente conduciría a su asesinato.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: John McFarlane, un carnicero, conoce a Mary en el gimnasio. Obsesionado y socialmente torpe, cree en una relación inexistente, y cuando lo rechaza, comienza su venganza.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Después de ser amenazada a punta de pistola por su violento novio, Nadia Ezaldein, estudiante de derecho de 22 años, finalmente reúne el coraje para poner fin a su relación abusiva. Pero esto es sólo el comienzo de la pesadilla de Nadia.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Después de conocer a Alissa Blanton en un Hooters en Florida, Roger Troy se convence de que pagó por la joven. Pronto, su delirio se convierte en una obsesión mortal.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Desde el momento en que Stephen Morgan ve por primera vez a Johanna Jinich en su curso de verano compartido en la Universidad de Nueva York, su vida corre peligro por su profundo odio racial.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Incluso después de ser puesta bajo protección de testigos, Lea Garafalo teme represalias por parte de su violento marido, afiliado a la mafia.

programme.desc: Lorin LaFave nunca podría haber imaginado que el encuentro en línea de su hijo de 14 años con un ciberacosador adolescente conduciría a su asesinato.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: John McFarlane, un carnicero, conoce a Mary en el gimnasio. Obsesionado y socialmente torpe, cree en una relación inexistente, y cuando lo rechaza, comienza su venganza.

programme.title: Acosadores que Matan
programme.desc: Después de ser amenazada a punta de pistola por su violento novio, Nadia Ezaldein, estudiante de derecho de 22 años, finalmente reúne el coraje para poner fin a su relación abusiva. Pero esto es sólo el comienzo de la pesadilla de Nadia.

programme.title: Evolution of Violence
programme.desc: Guatemala. La guerra terminó hace mucho tiempo. Aunque la gente quiere olvidarlo, la violencia continúa. Cada día, los periodistas informan sobre el próximo asesinato y los trabajadores sociales ayudan a los familiares de los asesinados. La sociedad sufre las consecuencias de los 36 años de guerra civil. Se encuentran fosas comunes en las montañas, ex rebeldes lloran a sus camaradas y un criminal de guerra tiene pesadillas sobre las cosas que ha hecho.

programme.title: Enfermeros que Matan
programme.desc: Utilizando el acceso exclusivo a ocho horas de entrevistas, testimonios de investigadores de la policía y reconstrucciones dramáticas, en este programa se cuenta la escalofriante historia de la enfermera Beverley Allitt.

programme.title: Enfermeros que Matan
programme.desc: ¿Era uno de los suyos - una enfermera de Lufkin, una asesina en serie? Acceso exclusivo a entrevistas policiales, testimonios de investigadores y reconstrucciones dramáticas de hechos reales

programme.title: Enfermeros que Matan
programme.desc: Charles Cullen fue un enfermero que se cree mató a más de 300 pacientes. Los expertos analizan las acciones y el motivo de este insidioso asesino en serie.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Seré asesinado
programme.desc: En mayo de 2009, el acaudalado abogado Rodrigo Rosenberg fue asesinado mientras paseaba en bicicleta por la Ciudad de Guatemala, un lugar con una alta tasa de homicidios. Antes de morir, se sintió amenazado, creyendo que lo matarían, especialmente tras el asesinato de su amante. Grabó un video acusando al presidente, que casi derrocó al gobierno. Una investigación sobre su caso reveló verdades impactantes.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: El examinador forense de escritura SC Leung nos muestra cómo distinguir entre estilos de escritura únicos y detectar un fraude.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una joven y vivaz artista que trabaja en un crucero de lujo atrae a tantos admiradores que comienzan a surgir celos. Después de una noche de socialización, no se presenta al ensayo. ¿Qué sucedió realmente tras la puerta cerrada de su camarote?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una terapeuta conocida por su actitud cariñosa se va de crucero con su marido para intentar arreglar su matrimonio, que está pasando por un mal momento. Por desgracia, su semana a solas acaba de forma trágica cuando ella cae desde la cubierta superior. ¿Es solo un accidente o ha pasado algo más siniestro?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una viuda millonaria y su hija adolescente se embarcan juntas en un crucero de cinco estrellas. Pero en una de las muchas paradas del viaje, los miembros de la tripulación hacen un espeluznante descubrimiento cuando encuentran el cadáver de la viuda metido en la maleta de su hija.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados recién jubilados se embarca en su tercer crucero tropical en menos de un año. La feliz y divertida pareja disfruta de las aventuras y el romanticismo de esta nueva etapa cuando ocurre una tragedia y los encuentran muertos en su camarote.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Dos novios del instituto, que se reencuentran después de 30 años, celebran sus cumpleaños haciendo un crucero juntos. Después de una noche de copas durante una excursión, uno de ellos aparece golpeado y estrangulado hasta la muerte. ¿Fue culpa de un escorpión empapado en alcohol?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Cuando a unos recién casados se les impide desembarcar en una excursión de un día por sospecha de falsificación de pasaportes, su relación comienza a desmoronarse. La bigamia conduce a un derramamiento de sangre. ¿Y quiénes serán las víctimas cuando se introduzca de contrabando una pistola a bordo?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Dos días después de cumplir 50 años, una profesora de trabajo social se embarca en un crucero de cumpleaños con su novio de toda la vida. Pero poco después de que el barco zarpe del puerto, ella sufre una trágica caída que le cuesta la vida. Las autoridades consideran que se trata de un accidente. Sin embargo, meses más tarde, el novio es acusado de homicidio en segundo grado.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un exmarido y una exmujer deciden reavivar su relación con un crucero. Pero, tras varios días a bordo del barco, la exmujer es dada por desaparecida. Más tarde, su cuerpo aparece flotando en el mar. La autopsia revela que fue asesinada.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una madre de dos hijos desaparece tras el segundo día del crucero vacacional de la familia. Tras una larga investigación, la policía señala al marido como sospechoso. ¿Qué ocurrió realmente?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Tras una noche loca en un crucero de fiesta, una joven y bella aspirante a actriz aparece muerta, pero las circunstancias que rodean su muerte son tan misteriosas como trágicas. ¿Podría su novio saber más de lo que dice?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un matrimonio se gasta una fortuna para celebrar su aniversario de boda por todo lo alto con un crucero único en la vida. Sin embargo, un grupo de terroristas a bordo del barco se ve obligado a tomar el control del buque después de que un mozo de acoplamiento descubra su alijo de armas.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una pareja que rompe y vuelve constantemente se embarca en un crucero de una semana para intentar reconstruir su relación. Todo va bien hasta que ocurre lo impensable y uno de ellos desaparece por la borda. ¿Fue un terrible accidente o un asesinato a sangre fría?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una escritora se va de crucero con su marido para celebrar su primer aniversario. Tras su desaparición, las cámaras de seguridad muestran cómo cae por la borda, lo que lleva a todos a preguntarse quién o qué la empujó.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un crucero se ve sacudido por una fuerte tormenta y cuatro amigos que viajan juntos buscan refugio en sus camarotes. Pero puede que una de las parejas no sea tan feliz como parece. ¿Cuál de ellos está a punto de sufrir un cambio fatal de destino?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Pat, his wife Sarah and his father John, who Pat claims is delusional, paranoid and a threat to his family. John, on the other hand, says he is convinced that Pat and Sarah are a threat to his and his wife’s lives. Pat and Sarah say they want a relationship but claim every attempt is misconstrued by John as some form of life-threatening conspiracy theory. Can Dr. Phil help this family reunite and patch their volatile relationship? And, Pat Smith, wife of retired Dallas Cowboys running back Emmitt Smith, joins Dr. Phil to discuss her new book, Second Chances. In this very intimate publication, Pat shares her journey from loss to redemption, her setbacks and recoveries, and how to let go of what’s holding you back, reinvent your life and rediscover purpose and joy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine if you found out your teenage daughter was falling in love with an older man on the Internet, concocting a plan to be together, 5,591 miles away in a war-torn country. This is an alert to all parents: Do you know what your child is doing on the computer?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with Heather, who says she is not at fault for her son's accidental overdose. But- where was she that night?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 2011, Robyn Gardner vanished while on vacation in Aruba with her companion, Gary Giordano, who was considered the prime suspect but was never charged in connection with her disappearance. Dr. Phil sits down with Gary to sort through the details and accusations in search of answers. What happened to Robyn Gardner? And, will Gary -- who maintains his innocence -- take a polygraph test?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lisa says her four beautiful adult daughters, Brandi, Wendi, Laci and Tahni, are "monsters" who pick on her, and their constant drama is tearing apart their family. However, all four daughters say it's Lisa who needs help. They claim she's a "textbook narcissist" who constantly plays the victim and has always put men before her family. Who is in the wrong here? Will Dr. Phil be able to bring this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does your child lie, steal, swear, or test you daily? Karen and Matt's son is only 4 years old, but he’s already cursing! Patty and Eric's 8-year-old son has been stealing since kindergarten. Now, they’re worried this could lead to a life of crime. Plus, a boy whose nickname is Dracula because he’s always biting somebody! And, what if you kept finding your 4-year-old in his birthday suit with the little girl next door? Beverly and Shea say they can't figure out why their kids like to get naked and play.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When these two families first met with Dr. Phil, their lives were in chaos. Have they begun to make changes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to mothers-in-law feuding with their sons-in-law and the relatives caught in the crossfire of these ongoing feuds. Greg and Amy have only been married for 10 months, but the couple says Amy’s mom, Terry, is ruining their relationship. Greg says his mother-in-law is manipulative and controlling, and she even called Child Protective Services on him for allegedly abusing Amy’s young children. Terry says Greg curses all the time, can’t keep a job and made her 5-year-old grandson wear a diaper to school as punishment for sucking his thumb -- a claim Greg denies. Is Terry a meddling mother-in-law or just a concerned grandmother? Then, Donna, says her son-in-law, Steve, is an abusive parent who hits her grandchildren. Steve refutes this and says his mother-in-law is a “man-hater” trying to ruin his marriage. Donna’s daughters, Rochelle and Shannon, speak up about the family drama, and you’ll be surprised to learn who they think is to blame. Whose side are you on? Tune in and decide!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues an intense discussion on negotiated infidelity. Chrissy, a mother of three, says her husband, Scott, refuses to dump his girlfriend and wants her to consider an open relationship. During their first appearance, things got heated when Tracy, Scott’s mistress of five years, came onstage to share her side of the story. Will Scott choose between his lover and his wife, or will both women kick him to the curb? Then, not everyone believes cheating is a bad thing. Holly Hill, author of Sugarbabe, says negotiated infidelity empowers women. She and her boyfriend, Dino, have been in an open relationship for three years, and they say this arrangement helps couples avoid strife and mistrust. What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, see a follow up with Charles, one of Dr. Phil’s most controversial guests, who wanted to explore a polyfidelity lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you’ve got it, flaunt it! Dr. Phil's guests say they’ve gone from ugly ducklings to hot tamales, but their loved ones think they’ve gone too far. Audrey says she looks extra hot now that she's 62 ... and she's got a 28-year-old boyfriend to prove it! Her close friend, Crystal, thinks Audrey should hang up her miniskirts and start baking cookies. Then, Bobbie lost 140 pounds and gained an insanely jealous husband because he thinks she looks way too sexy. See what happens when cameras follow Bobbie for a night on the town. Plus, a winner of the popular makeover show “The Swan” says she doesn't know how to handle her newfound beauty.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The last day in The House approaches as the four couples are put to one more test. To examine how each couple contaminates their relationship with unrealistic expectations, Dr. Phil gives one person from each pair a ""bump in the road."" Donning a pregnancy suit, Lacey surprises Kalin with the news that she's pregnant with someone else's child. Kalin tells her that he would leave her. Steve is made to look older and obese. Not surprisingly, Stephanie tells him that she would take control of his food intake. Lisa loses her good looks as she's made over to look like she lives on the street. Although Scott jokes with her and offers her a kiss, Lisa notes that he seems to be avoiding her. And, Tim is in a wheelchair and tells Lilly he won't be able to care for her like he used to. In fact, she'll need to help him out. Lilly says she wouldn't be able to help while pregnant, but she's confident that Tim would get used to his condition and be just as helpful as he was. Then, the couples have their final meeting with Dr. Phil. When asked to stand up if they think they should get married, everyone stands but Lisa and Scott. Dr. Phil pulls no punches as he tells the couples what their biggest challenges are. He criticizes Kalin for being a coward, a bully and ""astoundingly immature."" Dr. Phil implores him to change his attitude before they get married. He notes that Lacey is full of excuses for Kalin and after 10 years together, this must be what she believes she deserves. Dr. Phil tells Stephanie that she has a chip on her shoulder, and that every time she tests Steve and he stays, she feels reassured that he loves her. Stephanie feels picked upon and cries to Steve that she's being unfairly singled out. Dr. Phil tells her that she's a brat, and she needs to stop her controlling ways. If she really wants to know Steve's character, she should relinquish some of her iron-grip control and see what he does. Dr. Phil notes that Lisa and Scott want different things, and their expectations may never mesh. Lisa wants security, while Scott wants to be a rock star. He tells Scott that Lisa may be too high-maintenance for him, and he had better figure that out now before he finds himself getting his fourth divorce. When Lilly asks Dr. Phil if she and Tim are on the right track, he tells them that their biggest challenge is their youth and inexperience. They will always be parents together, but if they want to be spouses, they need to work at it. Finally, Dr. Phil reveals that there are more prizes to hand out for the challenges they've won. Lacey and Kalin will receive a GE appliance package worth $7,000 for winning a cooking challenge. Tim and Lilly won a Best Buy TV and some maternity clothes from Babystyle.com. Stephanie and Steve will receive a vacation at Lake Austin Spa Resort. Then, Dr. Phil asks Kalin and Lacey, and Scott and Lisa to join him outside, where they are surprised with brand new Hyundai Santa Fe SUVs for winning the teamwork challenge. As the couples rejoice, Steve leaves the room and angrily paces in his bedroom. In the end, armed with the knowledge they've gained from this experience, the couples claim to be cautiously optimistic about their futures

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you consider yourself smart, yet continue to make bad choices? This New Year, stop setting yourself up for pain and problems and put all the drama and bad choices in the rearview mirror! Dr. Phil says ex-spouses Jennifer and Phil are the perfect example of intelligent people whose choices could lead to terrible consequences. Since their divorce five years ago, they have been at war, and their three children are caught on the battleground. Jennifer says her “sperm donor” of an ex-husband doesn’t make enough of an effort to see their children and owes her nearly $30,000 in back child support. Phil says Jennifer is a habitual liar who “infects” the kids with lies about him and is on a mission to keep the kids from him. Dr. Phil doesn’t mince words when he tells them the mistakes they’re making. After hearing what their kids have to say, will this couple redefine their co-parenting plan before their children pay the price? And, one of the world's leading researchers in cognitive psychology and a member of the Dr. Phil Advisory Board, Dr. Art Markman, talks about his book, Smart Thinking, and the three-part formula for employing effective learning and smart thinking in your daily life. Plus, Rachel is ashamed of a bad habit that has followed her since childhood. Don’t miss Dr. Markman’s five keys to breaking any bad habit!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is in the hot seat when disgruntled viewers ask him, “What were you thinking?” One guest is fuming about the advice he gave an overzealous soccer mom. Another guest claims she’ll never forgive Dr. Phil for letting an insensitive father get off too easy. Why is she so irked? Then, a viewer asks Robin if she ever disagrees with Dr. Phil’s advice? You’ll be surprised at her response! Plus, a proud Texan has a bone to pick with Dr. Phil; and a discouraged schoolteacher gives him a grammar lesson.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Dr. Phil exclusive. A beautiful teen goes missing on spring break. Now, 7 years later, shocking new allegations – was Brittanee kidnapped, killed, and thrown into a gator pit? Her family gives their first interview since hearing the nightmarish details about what a jailhouse informant claims happened to their daughter. Plus, hear what a surprising guest has to say – do they know something about Brittanee’s murder?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two of “Profiles of a Pregnancy,” Dr. Phil tackles common decisions couples face during the 40-week roller coaster ride of pregnancy. One father-to-be refuses to be in the delivery room when his wife goes into labor; but she wants him by her side. Will this squeamish husband take Dr. Phil’s advice or will he opt for the waiting room? Then, Dr. Phil checks back with new parents-to-be Shannon and Morgan to see how they’re progressing. Plus, Robin surprises the couple with a brand new nursery!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike thought his wife, Bridgette's, excessive shopping was destroying their marriage. What started as a shopping intervention turned into an intervention with a family in crisis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: All newlyweds experience the typical ups and downs during their first year of marriage, but are these relationships already too far gone to be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obesity is a huge problem for adults in this country, but now it’s becoming an epidemic among children as young as 3 years old. Barbra says her 3-year-old daughter started gaining weight at six months old and now weighs 80 pounds. Barbra and her aunt, Dana, are baffled by what they believe is a medical mystery because they say the little girl doesn't overeat. Dr. Phil brings in two medical experts to get to the bottom of this issue. Is Barbra contributing to her child's weight gain? Then, Tammy says she can’t change her family's eating habits. She's obese, her 11-year-old is 175 pounds and her 9-year-old is 136 pounds. Her sister, Debbie, says the boys portion sizes are too big and the family is just lazy. Can Dr. Phil get Tammy to stick to a nutrition plan? You won’t believe the surprise he has for her! Plus, Jessica says her mom, Angie, is blind to the health issues of her 351-pound sister, Jaleisa, who is only 15. Angie says her mom never buys healthy food, and fears she has Munchausen’s syndrome. Angie says she can’t monitor Jaleisa’s eating habits all day. Can Angie turn this situation around and save her daughter’s life, or is it too late?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling, combative, outspoken guests whose loved ones want them off their back! First up, Tia demands perfection from her kids in school, music and sports. She's even picked out the perfect bride for her 14-year-old son! Then, he’s been called “the worst husband in Dr. Phil history!” When Deanna and Mike last appeared on Dr. Phil, Mike shocked the nation when he told his wife to “shut her suck hole!” He even tells her how to brush her teeth and take showers. Now they are back! Find out how their relationship has changed, and what will happen if Mike’s old habits re-appear!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's the affair that has everyone talking! Ed, a successful doctor, revealed to his wife, Kandi, that he was having an affair and his mistress is pregnant. Now, with the baby due in less than eight weeks, Dr. Phil checks back in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Screaming, making excuses, irrational outbursts ... No one knows how a drug addict behaves better than Brandon. With five years of sobriety under his belt, he and his mother, Debbie, are paying it forward. Now, Brandon meets his match! After seeing Dr. Phil’s intervention with Karli, Kim wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old daughter, Jaime, who's addicted to OxyContin. Five months ago, Kim’s family performed an intervention with Jaime. After agreeing to go to a detox facility, Jaime checked herself out and tried to commit suicide. Now, Kim says the young woman has started injecting cocaine and takes any opiate she can get her hands on. Don’t miss the most dramatic intervention yet. Will Jaime finally agree to get treatment, or will she fight everyone tooth and nail? Plus, addicted to heroin and OxyContin, Karli had overdosed and relapsed many times before her mother brought her to Dr. Phil and Brandon for help. How is she now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your mother so high on prescription drugs that she falls face first into her food, or your husband on a 15-day drug binge that ends with him passing out in front of your young children. For Dr. Phil's guests, these scenarios are their grim reality.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This is a true crime saga like no other. The Murdaugh family is one of the most prominent families in South Carolina and has served in powerful legal positions dating back nearly 100 years. Rumors swirled that Alex Murdaugh and his family could get away with anything. They have been tied to the mysterious deaths of their housekeeper, a high school classmate, and a young woman in a fatal boat crash. In June 2021, Murdaugh allegedly found his wife and younger son shot dead on their hunting lodge property. About a year later, Murdaugh was charged for their murders. The killings set off a bizarre chain of events that included Murdaugh staging his own murder. There are also nearly 100 financial crimes that are linked to him. Dr. Phil is joined by a panel of experts: former criminal prosecutor Loni Coombs; Michal Higdon, anchor and investigative reporter at WCSC-TV Charleston; forensic expert Joseph Scott Morgan; and former FBI agent Bobby Chacon to discuss this case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you risk breaking the law for your children’s education? What about for their safety? Kelley, a single mom, made headlines when she was prosecuted, convicted and sent to jail for listing her father’s address as her daughters’ residence, so they could attend a better school in a safer neighborhood. Kelley says she was working during the day and going to school at night, and after her house was burglarized, she wanted her children in a safer neighborhood for afterschool care. Kelley was convicted of two felony counts for tampering with government documents and spent nine days in jail. Did her punishment fit the crime? And, what other lies did she get caught in? Joining the discussion are Reverend Al Sharpton, columnist Bob Dyer, attorney David Singleton and a fellow single mom in the same school district.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a story that captured the nation: Warren Jeffs, the leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) and self-proclaimed prophet, was one of the FBI's 10 Most Wanted Fugitives for unlawful flight, sexual conduct with a minor and conspiracy to conduct sexual conduct with a minor. Captured in 2006, Jeffs was recently convicted of sexually assaulting children and sentenced to life, plus 20 years in prison. With an estimated 10,000 followers in his polygamous sect, what will become of Warren Jeffs' victims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: During the 2008 presidential election, Levi Johnston was thrust into the national spotlight as the boyfriend of Republican vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin's daughter, Bristol. The attention toward the young couple escalated when Bristol became pregnant. In the media, Johnston was portrayed as the sweet-faced 18-year-old set to marry into Sarah Palin’s happy family. But Levi says the moment the election wrapped and their son, Tripp, was born, the Palins grew distant. He and Bristol called off their engagement, and she later published a book criticizing Levi as a father. More than two years after their breakup, the 21-year-old dad tells his side of the story in his memoir, Deer in the Headlights: My Life in Sarah Palin’s Crosshairs. Dr. Phil sits down with Levi to discuss the book and his soured relationship with the Palins. What’s the latest in this political soap opera? And, find out why Levi says Bristol’s claims about his fathering skills couldn’t be any farther from the truth. Then, separated couple and feuding parents Devon and Bill are at war over custody of their 6-year-old son, Tyler. Can Dr. Phil help them call a truce? And, who’s the better parent for Tyler? Watch and weigh in on this heated custody battle! Levi Johnston, the father of Sarah Palin's 2-year-old grandson, dishes on his recent memoir and soured relationship with the Palins. Plus, Dr. Phil guides feuding parents through a heated custody battle over their 6-year-old son. Can they call a truce?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with some opinionated guests! Can he get them to see that their opinions and judgments can be hurtful?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it possible to be in love with two men at the same time? Orlena is desperate for help. She says she still has feelings for her ex-husband, Chad, and she adores her current husband, Brent. Chad is a soldier and when duty called, he fought in Iraq. He returned home a changed man and their love shattered forever. What changed Chad, and what caused Orlena to leave him? Devastated and heartbroken, Orlena moved on and into the arms of Brent. Two months after marrying Brent, Chad called and begged Orlena to come back. Find out Brent's strong message for Chad. Since Chad made initial contact with Orlena, they have talked numerous times, and he even spent three days visiting her. What has she been saying to Chad, and are the chats appropriate for a married woman to have? And, will Orlena honor her commitment to Brent or return to the man who broke her heart? Don't miss this heart-wrenching story of a woman torn between two wonderful men.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles one of the most dangerous trends affecting young adults today -- cyberbullying. Kalista, 20, claims she has been virtually assaulted for almost two years by Taylor, 20, a girl who Kalista says loves to attack people when they’re at their lowest point. Kalista says Taylor has posted photos of her online and written lies that she does drugs, is a stripper and a prostitute. Kalista says she’s not the only victim of Taylor’s alleged bullying -- Shelby, 22, and Shayna, 21, say they also have been targeted -- and she’s worried someone may be pushed too far. How do they say Taylor’s alleged actions have affected them? Taylor admits she has made nasty comments -- why does she say she was only defending herself? Dr. Phil brings all parties together to try to end the hostility. Are these young women ready to unplug and end the animosity? Plus, hear from the mother of a 12-year-old girl who tragically ended her own life after being cyberbullied. Will her story make an impact?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's one last test for three engaged couples before they start their lives as husband and wife - or not. See how they do in Dr. Phil's hilarious "Pre-Newlywed Game!"

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re devastated by a childhood trauma, and they want to confront the parent who they say caused it. First, Mandy says she hates her mother, Becky, for abducting her when she was a child, changing her name and keeping her in hiding for two years over allegations of abuse. Becky says she doesn’t regret going on the run with her daughter, and she’d do it again. The pair has only seen each other once in the past 22 years. Is it too late to start over? Then, Butch says his father, Ulysses, stole his childhood. He confronts his father for the first time in 33 years to find out why he killed his mother. Butch was just 12 years old and says he remembers every moment of that day, including being used to get his mother to come back into the house after his parents’ fight. Ulysses says the "unfortunate incident" was an accident, and he wants to make things right with his son before he dies. Will Butch get the answers he’s searching for and accept his father’s apology?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is fed up with teens being terrorized -- both in the schoolyard and online -- and he’s putting bullies on notice! This summer, he took the battle against cyber bullies before Congress, and now he’s kicking off his own Anti-Bully Movement. Learn how cyber bullying is affecting 12-year-old Dara, and why her mom, Toni, fears the tween may harm herself if she doesn’t get help. Then, hear why Michael, a self-proclaimed cyber bully, defends his keyboard antics. Plus, Congresswoman Carolyn McCarthy weighs in on bullying and cyber bullying and what can be done about this growing epidemic, and Parry Aftab, executive director and founder of StopCyberBullying.org, shares tips to keep your kids safe. Join the movement, and take Dr. Phil’s pledge to fight the abuse!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your weight getting so out of control that it confined you to your home, to a room, even to a bed. Dr. Phil's guests say they feel trapped and isolated in their homes and miss their loved ones.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A stay-at-home mother says she can't control her rage, and she takes it out on her kids. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of her five precious children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Steve is a raging alcoholic, and his wife, Sheila, violently abuses him when he drinks. Their two young daughters witness the fighting and are trapped in a war zone. Is it too late for this family to be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More and more newlyweds are declaring their honeymoon is over and they're ready to call it quits. One wife feels she's not the only woman in her relationship. And, Dr. Phil follows up with Shamika and Marlon to see if they are getting their marriage back on track.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues speaking with a family who claims they were torn apart because of an organization that professes love. Amy says she is “Mother God” and can heal the world with her group, Love Has Won. Her sister Chelsea does not think Amy is a deity, but alleges that she is a brainwashed “cult leader” who abandoned her family years ago and is putting other people’s lives at risk.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s the first Monday of the New Year, and in case you’re already having trouble with your resolutions, listen up! Dr. Phil and his special guests have advice for how to leave bad habits behind in 2009! Joining Dr. Phil is the king of comedy and author of the book Act Like a Lady, Think Like a Man, Steve Harvey. See the hilarious comic dish advice to Michelle, who wants to stop dating losers, Jain, who wants to stop judging people based on their zodiac sign, and Denise, who has a huge collection you won’t believe! Plus, Dr. Phil correspondent and comedienne Kathleen Madigan finds out what people on the streets are vowing to never do again in 2010. Everyone is in stitches during this lighthearted look at New Year’s resolutions. Don’t miss this show!

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Willa Davis es propietaria de una tienda de mascotas en San Francisco. Un día se reencuentra con el chico que la dejó plantada en el instituto, y tendrá que luchar con todas sus fuerzas contra su propio corazón para no volver a enamorarse, diez años después.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: Años 60. Sally Cauffield (Sharon Stone) es una estadounidense casada con Leo Cauffield (Rupert Everett), un inglés que lleva una doble vida: es periodista y agente de la KGB. Cuando, tras varios años de matrimonio, Leo desaparece, Sally lo busca y cuando lo encuentra se entera de que es un espía cuyo nombre en clave es “El Tercer Hombre”.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo llamado Thomas y dos adorables hijos. Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: Navidad Vuelve A Casa
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de su amor de la infancia y de su hijo de seis años, Abbey redescubre su espíritu navideño mientras recrea los adornos hechos a mano por su abuela para la feria anual de Navidad de su ciudad natal.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: En la Alemania de antes de la Primera Guerra Mundial, un joven se enamora de la esposa de su jefe, desatando un romance prohibido.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Dos compañeros de trabajo con una intensa rivalidad se ven obligados a colaborar, descubriendo que el odio y el amor están más cerca de lo que pensaban.

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Willa Davis es propietaria de una tienda de mascotas en San Francisco. Un día se reencuentra con el chico que la dejó plantada en el instituto, y tendrá que luchar con todas sus fuerzas contra su propio corazón para no volver a enamorarse, diez años después.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: Carlos, príncipe de una corona centroeuropea, llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso. María, que trabaja en la clínica veterinaria de su padre, conoce a Carlos por casualidad. Los dos ocultan su verdadera identidad y establecen una relación muy especial. Pronto se descubren sus mentiras mutuas. Carlos descubre que María tiene una hija y María se entera de la condición principesca de Carlos por unas fotos publicadas en la prensa sensacionalista.

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Jorge es músico, lo despiden tratando de encontrar una melodía entre el ruido de la calle, el mismo día que mueren su esposa y su hijo menor. Debe parecer cuerdo para cuidar de su hijo mayor Lucas, de lo contrario también lo perderá.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Hace diez años, una muchacha presenció con impotencia el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque y convirtiéndose en algo que los cazadores nunca hallaráan: un lobo. Ahora, a pesar de que vive al otro lado del mundo, Vivian Gandillon sigue huyendo.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un reconocido chef de Londres disfruta del éxito profesional hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo y abrir un pequeño restaurante en el campo. Así conocerá a Kate, una crítica gastronómica, que le ayudará a creer nuevamente en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de Tod Lubitch, un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico y que debe crecer y permanecer toda su vida confinado en un ambiente estéril. Pero se enamora y deberá elegir entre vivir plenamente o confinado.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: Septiembre la vida de Antonio se tambalea con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amiga a la que no ve 6 años.
